meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或一段草稿变成可直接发布的宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或卖点草稿,却急需一支能直接发出去的宣传片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or rough brief into a ready-to-publish promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if all you have is a product link or rough notes and you need a launch video now.

howto.what: 把产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简述,做成产品发布或推广视频。它按固定流程走:抓取网站、选设计预设、写分镜与脚本、配音频,再逐帧构建并渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你要求营销、发布或推广一个产品(含功能揭晓、应用/公司发布等)时触发;任何商业网址默认走它,网站导览类需求也归这里。

say.text: 把我这个产品官网做成一支发布视频
say.note: 会抓取该网站并进入逐帧构建流程

say.text: 用我粘贴的这段脚本做一支 SaaS 推广片
say.note: 脚本按原样保存,依 VO_MODE 处理

say.text: 给新功能做一支揭晓短片,用品牌配色
say.note: 用抓取到的设计令牌生成 frame.md

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video. Steps run in videos/<project>/: capture the site, pick a design preset, write storyboard and script, add audio, build frames, render renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; it's the default route for any commercial URL, and site tours/showcases land here too.

say_en.text: Turn my product site into a launch video
say_en.note: Captures the site and runs the frame-by-frame workflow

say_en.text: Make a SaaS promo from the script I pasted
say_en.note: Saves the script verbatim and follows VO_MODE

say_en.text: Make a reveal short for our new feature with brand colors
say_en.note: Builds frame.md from the captured design tokens
